mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 71 degrees with light drizzle near Reddan Soccer Park. Under the Waning Gibbous moon, look for the space station to pass by at 3:29 AM, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and traveling toward the northeast near Home Depot, staying low on the horizon. The overnight low will be 69 degrees, and rain is predicted.

Mayor Luke Diaz has proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month. This initiative highlights that 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin face food insecurity, and it encourages the community to volunteer and donate to local partners like the Second Harvest Foodbank to ensure everyone has enough to eat.

There is plenty happening in Verona, starting with the Kids Triathlon, Girls Try Hockey, and live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company all happening today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and keep an eye out for trivia nights starting September 1 at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In our weekly police report, on August 17 at 8:15 PM, the Department of Corrections requested assistance, leading officers to arrest a 21-year-old man on the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's flavor is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 51 minutes, so there is still time to stop by for a scoop before they close at 10 PM.
